implementedFindings: The applied-reasoning detector undercounted concrete case-to-framework and case-to-judgment questions, creating unnecessary repair work.
Applied-depth repair now targets only the required seats and refuses to rewrite an item whose immutable options or explanation fail admission.
Remaining off-topic items are repaired in one lesson batch and verified by two cold batch solves instead of receiving up to two generation attempts plus two solves per item.
Every verified replacement strips model-authored A/B/C/D labels before storage, with a final normalization pass before projection.
claimBoundary: This exact Qwen run proves a model-neutral compiler improvement and one clean Business Ethics package. It does not promote Qwen, train Gemma, validate the historical smoke adapter, complete the five-domain model gate, or substitute for independent instructor evidence.
